items.a: A cloud browser is a real browser that runs on remote infrastructure and is controlled by code or an AI agent, so you do not host browser servers yourself.

items.q: What is Browser Cloud for AI agents?
items.a: Browser Cloud is TestMu AI's cloud browser service. AI agents get real Chrome sessions with a localhost tunnel, session persistence, best-effort stealth and session replay.
Install the SDK with npm install @testmuai/browser-cloud, add your credentials and open a session from your agent code.

items.q: Can an agent reach my local app?
items.a: Yes. The built-in localhost tunnel lets cloud sessions reach apps running on your machine or staging environment.
